# Vendored: derekurban/design-system

Copied from https://github.com/derekurban/design-system at the tag in `PINNED_VERSION` (stylesheet, tokens, fonts, logos).
The app has no build step, so the files are vendored instead of installed from GitHub. Do not edit here; change the
design system upstream and re-copy. `app/styles.css` consumes these tokens and mirrors the system's components in CSS.
